execution_conditions: Use this worktree, its current recorded revision, the assigned scratch and harness-configured shared GOCACHE. Record any revision change and rerun the source census.
Use -count=1 to avoid replaying test-cache results. Reuse compiled Go objects. Record GOFLAGS, GOMAXPROCS and effective test parallelism; retain the defaults unless explicitly chosen before the run.

Bound the preparation and all test process groups with an external deadline within the total budget. Keep the existing 20m test binary timeout and production timeouts unchanged; stop earlier if the measurement allocation is spent.
Sample load and local start/end times once per command. Do not create load loops, enable YOYODYNE_TEST_CREATION_LOOP, or start a second broad suite.
Existing mandatory concurrency tests may run their own finite registration loops. Attribute those separately, and do not extend them.
Record command exit and test JSON actions, including skipped tests. Confirm exact selected names, subcases and package scope. This is scenario coverage, not a measured statement-coverage percentage.

One sample establishes invocation counts at this revision, not a statistically supported wall-time saving. Later conversions compare the same commands and attribution with disclosed load; overlapping family commands are not summed as one suite.
stop_conditions: Either required path remains unwritable: stop before compilation or profiling (the condition observed here).
Preparation, a scenario allocation or total wall budget expires: terminate the bounded process group, wait for exit and retain partial results as incomplete.
A command fails, an expected test is skipped or selected test names disagree: retain the result and stop further profiling.
The attribution instrument changes Git exit behavior, leaves unclassified origins or loses records: stop; do not publish the counts as a baseline.
No automatic repeats, no retries on moving load, and no additional scenarios beyond the nine-command plan.

attribution_plan.status: Method to implement and verify after the prerequisite; no wrapper or overlay was run in this repair.
attribution_plan.method: Use a scratch-only compiled PATH wrapper that delegates to the resolved real Git binary, preserves stdin/stdout/stderr and exit behavior, and records each harness/test-requested Git invocation in a separate per-invocation record. Annotate test call sites through a temporary Go overlay rather than changing production APIs or committing instrumentation.
origin_buckets: fixture setup: initial init/config/add/commit and committed fixture extensions
fixture assertion reads: gitOutput/gitLine and inline ancestry/ref checks
fixture mutations after setup: intentional drift, conflicts and neighbour registrations
fixture cleanup: test cleanup worktree removal, maintenance shutdown and pruning
fake forge operations: simulated remote merges and pushes
harness operations: production Git calls reached through the worktree manager and pipeline
call_sites_to_audit: internal/orchestrator/pipeline_test.go: pipelineRepository, attemptPipelineGit, gitOutput, writeCommitted callers and cleanup helpers
internal/gitworktree/*_test.go: direct Git helpers and intentionally intercepted Git commands in the control scenario
attribution_plan.important_limit: A shared helper such as attemptPipelineGit serves setup, assertions, later mutations and cleanup. Tag callers/phase explicitly; labeling every helper command as setup or counting init/config alone is not a valid separation. Keep forge simulation separate from harness production work.
attribution_plan.test_attribution: Tag t.Name() at test call sites and propagate repository/worktree ownership for harness attribution where unambiguous. Do not assign parallel Git commands by nearest test JSON timestamp. Resolve nested repository paths by longest prefix. Unresolved or shared ownership remains explicit and invalidates a per-test ranking.
attribution_plan.counts: Count only wrapper entries for Git requested by tests/harness. Use the real Git binary for Git-internal children so rebase/fetch descendants are not counted twice; document this scope. Normalize -C/-c global options when grouping commands. Publish totals by origin and subcommand, and compare origin sums with wrapper entries.
attribution_plan.cpu_and_wall: Use /usr/bin/time -l around each test command for whole-command user/system CPU and elapsed time, which include compilation, harness logic and descendants. Use child resource usage and elapsed time in the wrapper for Git user/system CPU and wall duration. Git wall durations overlap and are not suite wall time; Git CPU attribution includes that invocation descendants and excludes the wrapper own CPU.
attribution_plan.overhead: Disclose instrument overhead and confirm wrapper conformance during the 120-second preparation allocation. Do not silently compare an instrumented run with an uninstrumented historical result.
attribution_plan.outputs: Commands, test JSON, timing output, attribution records and load observations belong in assigned scratch. The reviewed evidence artifact carries aggregates, conditions and locations; no scratch content is added to the worktree.

bounded_conversion_candidates.name: Path-check selection tables
bounded_conversion_candidates.maximum_scope: The four top-level path-check tests listed in the focused scenario; stay in internal/orchestrator and retain integration representatives.

existing_assertions.assertions: Walked path runs; test-path exclusion and unrelated path skip; command order reaches review evidence and stage reason records the matching path.
Unreadable path list adds the gate and explains why.
Editing the paths list to empty cannot suppress the gate.
Editing the paths list to exclude the changed program cannot suppress the gate.

bounded_conversion_candidates.smaller_test: Call existing pathChecksFor with temp-directory lists and explicit changed paths, then withPathChecks and describePathChecks. Reuse internal/checks path-pattern coverage rather than duplicate its full parser matrix. No Git needed for policy and ordering cases.
bounded_conversion_candidates.retained_integration_assertions: Keep a real-Git matched path-check pipeline through review and stage persistence, and a paths-list edit pipeline proving selection uses actual changed paths. Keep execution-order/evidence assertions on those representatives, not merely on a policy return value.
bounded_conversion_candidates.priority: Unranked until the family is measured.

bounded_conversion_candidates.name: Unusable landing-marker combinations
bounded_conversion_candidates.maximum_scope: One existing top-level test, TestAMarkerTheHarnessCannotUseTakesTheParkingInstead, containing four marker subcases; no settlement or closure redesign.

existing_assertions.assertions: Self, missing, closed and reverse-dependency markers resolve to no blocker with their distinct reason; pipeline still integrates, parks the item and records why in outcome, parking and notes.

bounded_conversion_candidates.smaller_test: Construct activeRun with state.WorkItemID and Pipeline.Tracker using orchestratortest.Tracker; call existing resolveImpediment for each table case. Assert returned blocker and reason. Include a confirmed open marker control and an injected Show refusal within this bounded group.
bounded_conversion_candidates.retained_integration_assertions: Keep one unusable-marker pipeline proving promotion, parking, outcome and notes; keep TestALandingThatNamesItsImpedimentLeavesTheItemOpenWaitingOnIt and TestADependencyRefusedAtTheSettlementSaysParkedOnEverySurface. Resolver-only tests do not prove settlement or surface agreement.
bounded_conversion_candidates.priority: Unranked until the family is measured.

bounded_conversion_candidates.name: Verification-record extraction and per-attempt isolation
bounded_conversion_candidates.maximum_scope: At most the three top-level selfcheck tests in the policy-focused scenario; parser behavior remains owned by internal/selfcheck.

existing_assertions.assertions: Verification is read from the whole reply even when an unreadable landing claim consumed the remaining text.
Malformed verification records a problem and the hand-back names it; the repaired attempt reaches integration.
Readable execution evidence is used for its attempt; an absent record on a separate run does not inherit it.

bounded_conversion_candidates.smaller_test: Exercise existing activeRun.claimVerification and recordVerification over whole/rest reply pairs and successive attempts; assert state/outcome parity, Problem, removal from summary and clearing of a prior record. Reuse selfcheck.Extract/Record.Missing coverage already present rather than create a second parser.
bounded_conversion_candidates.retained_integration_assertions: Keep a malformed verification hand-back repaired by the same developer, TestAChangeNobodyRanIsHandedBackAndNeverReachesAReviewer, TestAProbeTheEnvironmentRefusedEndsTheRunNamingIt and TestWhatTheDeveloperExecutedReachesTheReviewer. Parsing alone does not prove that review and integration gates refuse the change.
bounded_conversion_candidates.priority: Unranked until the family is measured.
bounded_conversion_candidates.source_limit: The current per-attempt test sends valid evidence in its first invocation and separately tries a new run with no evidence; it does not by itself drive valid then missing evidence through two attempts of one run. The smaller table should explicitly exercise that sequence while retaining the existing no-inheritance assertion.
